main_text.head: THEODORVS BEZA
IOHANNI IACOMOTO fratri ac fymmystæ suo charifsi-mo, Gratiam & Pacem à Domino.
main_text.p: NArro tibi, mi frater, quod nunquam mihi in mentem venerat. Scis enim quo loco habere nostros illos, etsi nec, opinor, per se culpandos, nec prorsus vanos ludos consueuerim. Petiit à me, vel potius contendit nobilissimus ille noster Zastrisellus, suafore, credo, Paludio Philophilo nostro, ne Abrahamum illum nostrum sacrificantem, siue Comœdiam ab exitu lætissimo, siue ab argumenti sanctissimi grauitate Tragœdiam libue-rit appellare, diutius paterer ab ea quam procurauit nostrorum τοῦ μαστιγίων edi-

page.notes: The initial N is a large woodcut initial, transcribed as "NArro". The word in Greek at the line end is printed as "πομπατίων" in the scan; transcribed as printed in Greek letters, uncertain [?]. The small bottom-of-page marks are illegible; no clear footnote text is readable.
